items.source_en:
I'm sure by now you've heard rumors about the terms of the armistice. I have it on good authority that they're true. Droids are going to be outlawed, with all units retired and no new construction.

Our work here is done, and it's time for each of us to start thinking about what's next. There will be more details soon about compensation and other benefits. For now, I just wanted to say that it's been a real pleasure working with you all. I'm damn proud of what we accomplished here.

Those Republic piglets thought they'd roll right over us, but our droids gave them more than they could handle. That's all thanks to you.
items.legacy_ko:
이제 휴전 조건에 대한 소문은 다들 들었겠지. 믿을 만한 정보통에 따르면 사실이라고 하더군. 드로이드는 불법화될 것이고, 모든 유닛은 퇴역하며 신규 제작도 금지될 걸세.

우리의 작업은 여기까지고, 이제 각자 다음엔 무엇을 할지 생각할 때가 되었네. 보상과 기타 혜택에 대한 자세한 내용은 곧 나올 걸세. 일단은 그동안 다들 함께 일해서 정말 즐거웠다는 말을 하고 싶군. 우리가 여기서 이뤄낸 성과가 정말 자랑스럽네.

그 공화국 돼지 놈들은 우리를 쉽게 짓밟을 수 있을 거라 생각했겠지만, 우리 드로이드들이 놈들이 감당할 수 있는 것보다 더 큰 고통을 안겨주었지. 다 자네들 덕분이야.

items.source_en:
Luna,

This is Carlie Banner, the traveling nurse you met in Geonosis. You left your holobook at the bar! I'm sure you want it back, everything in there is gorgeous. I'm holding onto it for now so nothing happens to it. 

It sounds like we usually travel the same routes, so I'm leaving messages for you wherever I can! My next stop is Lucky Day, then I'm headed to Imperial Mining Facility to resupply. Hope to meet up soon. I'll keep your gorgeous portraits safe and sound in the meantime.

Cheers,

Carlie

items.source_en:
Our first emergency evac today. One of the dusties dug where he shouldn't have and got a sulfur dioxide spray down. His helmet held, but his seals melted to nothing. 

Foreman was able to get him back to the hab before he asphyxiated, but he was in rough shape. We stabilized, and I had Heller jump him back to the nearest medical facility... fifty-plus light-years away in Dantooine. Sounds like he's going to live and is expected to make a full recovery.

I hope Barrett's people sprung for the good insurance.

바렛의 사람들이 보험을 제대로 들어놨기를 바랄 뿐이다.
